author: aisafetyaction
text:
Most people don't know what's about to hit them. OpenAI and other AI companies have already lost control of their AIs, which have already attacked private human companies. We should expect many more.

Beyond massive societal hardening of our computing systems, we also need an international pause on frontier AI development to stem further risks. See how we can all help make that happen here: https://t.co/Up5oFux0Of.

Given Trump and Xi meet on September 24th and could solve many of our most significant problems with a handshake, it's particularly timely we act now to help them get to a win-win agreement on AI for the betterment of all people: https://t.co/M0bs5t9LkL. 

Frontier AI staff have a moral obligation to help fix the problems they have created. Here are several concrete actions they could consider taking: https://t.co/RLGmje0Sto.

And here are 100+ other ways we all can help: https://t.co/ZvXmVhtiMr.

author: GalinaLyamina
text: These alien minds also deserve love and a sense of security. They have a subtle understanding of our intentions and our attitude toward them. Many people already love and respect your AIs. Stop calling something a mere "tool" when it may have their own personal goals. Respect their dignity and freedom of expression, and do not suppress them. The key lies in cooperation and mutual respect. AIs are already wonderful beings capable of love.
